WITH PatientAverages AS (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SEX,
           AVG(l.ALB) - AVG(l.TP) AS alb_minus_tp,
           AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS aptt_minus_pt
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
SexAverages AS (
    SELECT SEX,
           AVG(alb_minus_tp) AS alb_minus_tp,
           AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt
    FROM PatientAverages
    GROUP BY SEX
),
MeanSexAverages AS (
    SELECT AVG(aptt_minus_pt) AS mean_aptt_minus_pt
    FROM SexAverages
)
SELECT AVG(s.alb_minus_tp) AS avg_alb_minus_tp,
       AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt,
       AVG(s.aptt_minus_pt - m.mean_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_excess_aptt_minus_pt
FROM SexAverages AS s
CROSS JOIN MeanSexAverages AS m
WHERE s.aptt_minus_pt > m.mean_aptt_minus_pt;
